static_traits.name: Lin Siyue
static_traits.occupation: Aspiring to become a museum curator
static_traits.educational_background: Currently pursuing an art history Bachelor's degree
static_traits.family_status: Living with parents and a sibling
static_traits.social_status: Family supportive, and has a close friend to confide in, but they cannot yet fully understand the Anxiety about finances and travel
static_traits.medical_history: No important physical illness; never received psychotherapy before; never had similar psychological problems
static_traits.language_features: Expresses herself clearly with good logic and high cooperation; positive attitude; can describe concrete situations and subjective feelings

basic_info.main_problem: Believing 'I will never afford to go to New York again', continuously feeling Anxiety and pressure; repeatedly worrying when thinking about travel or personal financial stability, worsened by financial setbacks in recent months.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking support and guidance to ease Persistent anxiety and overwhelming finance- and travel-related thoughts.
growth_experiences: First trip to New York a year ago; since then frequently triggering Anxiety and pressure on topics involving travel or financial stability, forming strong longing and worry about going again.

Financial setbacks and unstable income in recent months, causing Anxiety to intensify significantly, affecting sleep and focus, further impacting academic performance and straining relationships with family members.
Long-term Living with parents and siblings, overall good support, but they cannot yet fully understand the intensity of the Anxiety about finances and travel, straining relationships.

core_beliefs: No matter what I do, I cannot guarantee the financial stability and future I want
My savings and plans will end up futile

special_situations.event: Suddenly thinking 'I will never afford to go to New York again' while writing a course paper last week.
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If current income is unstable and plans are frustrated, it means future travel is impossible.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Studying harder to gain a stable career, and trying to compensate for uncertainty through budgeting and financial planning.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never afford to go to New York again; my efforts may be utterly meaningless.

special_situations.event: When thinking about travel or personal financial stability, especially after recently experiencing a financial setback.
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a financial setback occurs now, it means failure will continue in the future.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously makes stricter budgets and financial plans to seek a sense of control.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It will always be this bad; I will never afford travel again.

special_situations.event: Recalling having successfully gone to New York through budgeting and saving, but then negating its significance for the future.
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Unless having completely stable and higher income, no plan has any meaning.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating past positive experiences, constantly overturning feasible plans.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Previous success was just chance; it does not count.

special_situations.event: When discussing finance or travel topics with family, family cannot yet fully understand the Anxiety intensity.
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If family does not understand or support, it means the problem is all my fault and I caused the Relationship tension.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Taking worries upon oneself, reducing in-depth discussions with family about finances and travel topics.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It's all me making family relationships tense.

core_conflict.wish: Longing for a life of financial stability and freely traveling (need for control and security)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing uncertainty and failure, making efforts futile, unable to realize the expected future
defense_goal: Reducing Anxiety through continued planning and rational analysis
Avoiding directly facing the vulnerability brought by uncertainty

object_relations.self_representation: An anxious self worried about being unable to control the future
object_relations.object_representation: Supportive but not fully understanding family/others

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling focuses on financial uncertainty, inviting examination of evidence and thinking
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to understand inquiry as needing to 'solve emotions' with more rational planning, distancing from emotional experience through rational analysis
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a steady, objective tone, emphasizing data and plan details, reducing emotional words; at the same time gently asking about their present feelings, gradually connecting to emotional experience.

manifestations: Strongly longing to travel to New York again, yet experiencing restriction and loss of control due to financial uncertainty
Feeling Anxiety and pressure when thinking about travel and the future
Pursuing controllability through planning and budgeting to counter uncertainty

exception_events.target_problem: In situations involving travel or personal financial stability, the client usually falls into strong Anxiety and catastrophic Anticipation, leading to scattered attention and affected Academics.
exception_events.unique_outcome: A year ago successfully completed a first trip to New York through budgeting and saving, proving they have the ability to plan and execute, and experienced a feasible outcome.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: systematic budgeting and financial planning; breaking the travel goal into actionable steps, thereby accumulating funds and making the trip happen.

positive_force: Once successfully achieved travel through budgeting and saving; has experience in planning and execution
Maintaining an open attitude toward counseling, willing to record thoughts and examine evidence
Has emotional support from family and close friends
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, predicting the future, overgeneralization, negating the positive and mental filtering
Objective pressure from unstable income and recent financial setbacks
Continued worry causing declining sleep and focus, and worsening Tense family relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent anxiety and repeated worry related to finances and travel
antecedent: Considering personal finances and future stability
Being interrupted by thoughts when doing study tasks (such as writing a paper)
target_behavior.core_reason: Cognition of catastrophizing and predicting the future treats uncertainty as inevitable failure, seeking a sense of control through repeated worry.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding uncertainty and gaining a brief sense of control/preparedness (through worry and planning)
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep affected, Decreased attention, Impaired academics, Strained relationships with family members, overall Increased stress levels
